name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 9, 2010
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Youth Director Kelly Perez of Oak Hills Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring March 10, 2010, "Leslie Jantz Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation declaring the March 2010 "California State University San Marcos Month" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
NEA Challenge America Fast Track Review Grant (CDC)
C4.
State Route 78 Corridor Enhancement - Cooperative Agreement (CC)
C5.
Amendment of the Vista Municipal Code to Adopt by Reference the County Regulatory Ordinances for Tattoo Parlors (CC)
C6.
Fee Waiver for Security Automotive at 1100 E. Vista Way (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Proposed Assessments (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , confirming the 2010-2011 Annual Report for the CVBID, and levying the assessment for FY 2010-2011; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , appointing the Advisory Board of the CVBID for FY 2010-2011.
PH2.
Appeal of Planning Commission’s Approval of PC8-133 (Amendment 2) at 1244 N. Santa Fe Avenue, ARCO AM/PM, applicant (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing, and;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving the amendment to the Special Use Permit and Comprehensive Sign Program to: a) allow a gas station use; b) remodel the interior and re-image existing food mart building and existing canopy; c) convert existing auto service bays into a self-serve drive-thru carwash facility; and d) deny the application for beer and wine sales for off-site consumption at 1244 N. Santa Fe Avenue.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
